value.note: Political-economy model of an incumbent's strategic policy choice under electoral competition with probabilistic two-party voting. C0.reason: The paper models parties strategically choosing platforms to win a two-party election, which counts as a strategic aspect of a voting procedure; since INELIG fits about equally well, the doubt rule selects the first-listed code, ELIG.
